           CASE WHEN ri.temp_sens = 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN ri.temp_sens = 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN ri.temp_sens = 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS temp_weight,

    FROM resting_items ri

           CASE WHEN ww.conserve_status = 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN ww.conserve_status = 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN ww.conserve_status = 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN ww.conserve_status = 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN ww.conserve_status = 'Critical' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS conserve_val
